examined_formations.title: FX_TRIGGERED_COMMERCE_PRICE_UPDATE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 汇率触发的电商价格自动调整
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Live exchange rates are external to the merchant store and price writes are buyer-controlled. Current Shopify apps such as KurSync already convert source-currency costs into store prices, apply margin buffers/minimums/rounding and schedule automatic updates when FX moves. The exact external-trigger→price-state loop is already packaged at low SaaS price points.

examined_formations.title: WEATHER_TRIGGERED_AD_CAMPAIGN_CONTROL
examined_formations.chinese_title: 天气触发的广告启停与出价控制
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Weather is an independent external event and campaign/geo/bid states are writable by the advertiser. WeatherAds already changes Google Ads campaign activation, geo targeting and bids from weather rules as frequently as every 15 minutes. The cross-system trigger does not preserve an unowned edge.

examined_formations.title: COMMODITY_INDEX_TRIGGERED_B2B_PRICE_UPDATE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 商品指数触发的 B2B 价格调整
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Commodity/feedstock indexes are external, while price lists/formula contracts are buyer-controlled and directly affect margin. Rockton Pricing Management automatically imports commodity indexes/external cost feeds and applies pricing rules through ERP integration; Pricefx and Vendavo explicitly support raw-material/market-index formula pricing. Exact incumbent coverage is mature.

examined_formations.title: COMPETITOR_STOCKOUT_TRIGGERED_REPRICING
examined_formations.chinese_title: 竞品缺货触发的自动提价
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Competitor stockout is an external web signal and a merchant price change is buyer-owned. RepricerBot, Retailgrid, Repricer.com and similar tools already monitor competitor stock/price and automatically raise or otherwise reprice products inside margin guardrails. The external signal is already commoditized by the pricing category.

examined_formations.title: DAY_AHEAD_ENERGY_PRICE_TRIGGERED_EV_CHARGING_SCHEDULE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 日前电价触发的 EV 充电调度
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Day-ahead EPEX/Nord Pool prices are external signals and OCPP gives operators direct charger control. Plugchoice already consumes dynamic tariffs and schedules charging under price thresholds/automatic mode across OCPP chargers. Research literature in 2026 also demonstrates tariff-aware OCPP scheduling, so the trigger/action mechanism is neither sparse nor unowned.

examined_formations.title: EVENT_TRIGGERED_PARKING_RATE_UPDATE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 赛事活动触发的停车费率调整
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Nearby games/concerts are external demand events and parking operators control rate state directly. Inugo automatically adjusts rates from scheduled events; GENIE uses local events, weather and traffic in automated pricing; Mitte pushes event surge rates across reservation channels. The event→rate mapping is already a commercial parking control surface.
